_comment: Which free models Kotiko asks, in what order, and the lookup client's budgets (slice 10). Both runtimes read it: the server at compile time (Kotiko.Spec), the extension from extension/spec/. `prefer` and `prefer_respell` come from the evaluation in `evidence`; re-order them only with a newer run of spec/eval/run-eval.mjs. `deny` patterns use * as a wildcard and are matched against the model id; `openrouter/*` keeps the free router (which may pick a model without JSON mode) out of the default chain (slice 10 open question 1).

evidence.source: spec/eval/RESULTS.md, "2026-10-02 · live · set all · spec 2.0.0" (133 cases per model)

nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free.note: Best at lookups; its respell answers were often dropped by the checks (ru en 9 of 15, zh en 3 of 4).

dots-studio/dots-3-note-preview:free.note: Steadiest at respell (1 respelling of 49 dropped by the checks), strong Russian stress.

apodex/apodex-1.1-mini:free.note: Fastest; no respell answer dropped, but weaker letters and stress.

google/gemma-4-31b-it:free.note: Rate limited upstream for the whole run; unscored.
